On P5_PLUS chips and later
column2: the NQ rings have subrings for RX and TX

column1: completions respectively. These subrings are passed to the poll
function instead of the base NQ
column2: but each ring carries its own

column1: copy of the software ring statistics.
For stats to be conveniently accessible in __bnxt_poll_work()
statistics memory should either be shared between the NQ and its
subrings or the subrings need to be included in the ethtool stats
aggregation logic. This patch opts for the former
efficient and less confusing having the software statistics for a
ring exist in a single place.
Before this patch
column2: the counter will not be displayed if the ""wrong""

column1: cpr->sw_stats was used to increment a counter.
